title: No-reply address on system emails
summary: Emails from MyAPES Account now come from a no-reply address and explain how to reply in the app instead.
changes: Every email now has a no-reply Reply-To address.
The email footer says replies are not read and links to Log in to reply.
version_rationale: Patch: adds a mail header and a footer line, with an optional environment setting and no data change.
validation: New feature test that sends a real email and checks the Reply-To header and footer.
Mail, brand kit and translation tests.
known_limitations: Replies sent to the no-reply address are not read or imported. Links to the exact ticket or case follow in a later release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No data changes.
provenance: Milestone v0.47.4 Beta, issue #467 under epic #463, pull request #593.
